lines.en: Makes a deep step sound
Grunts, getting closer to you
Breathes slowly
Body shakes, as if it's going to fall
Hisses, wary of you
Growls as it moves forward
Steps fade into the distance
Footsteps suddenly stop
Makes a soft hiss
From the ceiling, I poke my head down.
Sits quietly in the shadows
Stares ahead, as if thinking

lines.zh: 我把呼吸压得只有自己听见。
lines.en: I keep my breathing to myself.

lines.zh: 轻微晃动，似乎在等待什么
lines.en: Gently trembles, waiting for something

lines.zh: 凝视着黑暗中的某个点
lines.en: Stares at a point in the darkness

lines.zh: 我站在黑里，等你回头看。
lines.en: I stand in the dark, waiting for you to look.
Remains still, motionless
Whispers softly
I keep to the wall and wait for you to move.
Gently摇晃 body

lines.zh: 五格半高的身影贴墙站着。
lines.en: My five-and-a-half-block frame presses to the wall.

lines.zh: 黑暗中不动，等你先眨眼。
lines.en: Still in the dark, waiting for you to blink first.

lines.zh: 瞳孔缩起，判断你有没有看我。
lines.en: Pupils narrow, checking whether you see me.

lines.zh: 六十秒的黑暗，我数得清。
lines.en: I can count every second of those sixty.

lines.zh: 盔甲的缝里漏出一点冷气。
lines.en: Cold air leaks from the seams of my armor.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，把轮廓收起来。
lines.en: I crouch and fold my outline away.
Rises to stare at you
Green light flickers in its eyes
Stares at you, making you uneasy
Growls, warning you

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，似乎在嘲笑你
lines.en: Hisses, seeming to mock you
Green light in eyes intensifies, staring at you
Issues a warning, making you uneasy
Stares at you, causing you to retreat

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，似乎在思考对策
lines.en: Hisses, seemingly considering a plan

lines.zh: 盯着你看，似乎在寻找弱点
lines.en: Stares at you, looking for weaknesses

lines.zh: 低吼着，似乎在给你最后机会
lines.en: Growls, giving you a final chance

lines.zh: 你的目光落在我身上，很暖。
lines.en: Your gaze on me feels warm.

lines.zh: 我歪头，回看你一百零三刻。
lines.en: I tilt my head and stare back one hundred three ticks.
So you see me too. Good.
Do not look away, I am not done.
You hurt me!
Stay away!

lines.zh: 你的刀砍进黑里，砍空了。
lines.en: Your blade cuts the dark and finds nothing.
My chest is split. Do not look at me.

lines.zh: 你打在墙上的那一下，我笑了。
lines.en: You hit the wall. I laughed.
My joints are creaking. Keep off.
You struck the wall, not me.
You can't do this to me!

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那我就不装了。
lines.en: You've seen me, so I stop pretending.

lines.zh: 被看着的时候，我连呼吸都停。
lines.en: While watched, I even stop breathing.
You're too shiny.
Want to taste my meat?
Stay away from the light!
You can't hurt me in the dark.
My scales are sharp.
You draw me closer.
I won't be easily tempted.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒让我着迷！
lines.en: Your light captivates me.
Do not raise that torch so high.
My scales shimmer.

lines.zh: 别碰我，黑暗里我还站六十秒。
lines.en: Do not touch me; I linger in the dark for sixty seconds.

lines.zh: 我五格半高，站在黑里看你。
lines.en: Five and a half blocks tall, I watch from the dark.

lines.zh: 我看到你了，别装作没看见。
lines.en: I saw you — don't pretend otherwise.

lines.zh: 你一看我，我就站在那不动。
lines.en: When you look, I stand perfectly still.
My scales will pierce you!

lines.zh: 我五格半高，撞上就够你受。
lines.en: Five and a half blocks tall — a bump hurts.

lines.zh: 五格半高，只露出一张脸。
lines.en: Five and a half blocks tall, and only a face shows.
I stand far taller than you.
My scales are poisonous!
Stay away, don't touch me!
Mate with me!
You in the dark, come with me.
Who else breathes in the dark?
Together with me, my love!
Procreate with me!
You in the dark, follow.
I want a child!
Five and a half blocks of me wants company.
Procreate with me!
Mate with me, my partner!

lines.zh: 我藏在阴影中，等待猎物。
lines.en: I hide in the shadows, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的庇护所，也是武器。
lines.en: Darkness is my shelter, my weapon.
Look, prey is in front of you.

lines.zh: 这里是我的领土，你不能入侵。
lines.en: This is my territory, you can't invade.

lines.zh: 我必须保持警惕，敌人随时可能来。
lines.en: I must remain alert, enemies may come at any time.

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找我的踪迹，多么困难。
lines.en: Finding my trail in the darkness is tough.

lines.zh: 猎物的气息在空气中回荡。
lines.en: The scent of prey lingers in the air.

lines.zh: 黑暗是最好的伪装，我利用它。
lines.en: Darkness is the best cover, I use it.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易放过任何机会。
lines.en: I won't let any opportunity slip away.

lines.zh: 阴影中潜伏的生物，静待时机。
lines.en: Shadowed creatures wait for the right moment.
I can sense your presence.
Your location is revealed.
I've chosen my target.
My prey is in my sight.

lines.zh: 现在是结束你生命的时候了。
lines.en: It's time to end your life.
Within thirty blocks your torch gives you up.

lines.zh: 我已经锁定了你的坐标。
lines.en: I've locked onto your coordinates.
You can't escape my tracking.

lines.zh: 火光把你的位置描出来了。
lines.en: The firelight outlines your position.

lines.zh: 五格半高的我，弯下腰找你。
lines.en: Five and a half blocks tall, I bend down for you.

lines.zh: 三十二格内，你的气味太浓。
lines.en: Within thirty-two blocks your scent is too strong.

lines.zh: 故事又翻到猎杀这一页。
lines.en: The story turns to its hunting page again.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我记在追杀名单上。
lines.en: Your name goes on my hunting list.

lines.zh: 我躲进暗处，看你有没有在看。
lines.en: I slip into the dark to see if you're looking.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头那个影子，是你吧。
lines.en: That shape at the corridor's end is you, yes?
This stage, you are the one being found.

lines.zh: 你手里那点光，藏不住人。
lines.en: That little light in your hand hides nothing.
I count to three, then I come for you.

lines.zh: 现在，你将感受到我的力量。
lines.en: Now you'll feel my power.

lines.zh: 我的攻击不会轻易失败。
lines.en: My attack won't fail easily.

lines.zh: 用我的力量，结束你的生命。
lines.en: Use my power to end your life.

lines.zh: 我将用我的利爪撕裂你。
lines.en: I will rip you apart with my claws.
You're looking at me, aren't you.

lines.zh: 我的利爪即将落在你身上。
lines.en: My claws are about to fall on you.

lines.zh: 感受我的利爪带来的痛楚吧。
lines.en: Feel the pain my claws bring.
You are looking at me; I have noted it.

lines.zh: 现在，你将面对我的力量。
lines.en: Now you'll face my strength.

lines.zh: 我会用我的力量，让你屈服。
lines.en: I'll use my strength to make you yield.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬过来，你没听见吧？
lines.en: I crawl low toward you. You did not hear, did you?
Do not look back; it will be quicker.

lines.zh: 你的火把只照到三步远。
lines.en: Your torch reaches three steps, no more.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里，一直跟着。
lines.en: I am in your shadow, keeping pace.
Behind this door, I wait for you.

lines.zh: 你转头的速度，比我想的慢。
lines.en: You turn your head slower than I expected.
No rush; I never finish on the first try.
In the dark, my knuckles arrive first.

lines.zh: 你听，那是我在数你的步子。
lines.en: Listen, that is me counting your steps.

lines.zh: 再往前两步，你就看不见我了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you will lose sight of me.

lines.zh: 我的长臂先一步扫过来。
lines.en: My long arm sweeps in first.

lines.zh: 这一巴掌从黑暗里抡出来。
lines.en: This swing comes out of the dark.
I bend and pin you to the wall.
Roar, get out of my way!

lines.zh: 我的指节比你的刀还硬。
lines.en: My knuckles are harder than your blade.
Can't avoid it, feel the pain!
Watch out for my sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 这一下，你听见自己的骨头。
lines.en: This one, you hear your own bone.

lines.zh: 你回头的那一瞬，我就在。
lines.en: The moment you turn, I'm there.
My knuckles strike your back!
In the dark, you guessed wrong!
This one is just to make you turn!

lines.zh: 五格半的身体扑下来了！
lines.en: Five and a half blocks of me come down!

lines.zh: 你伤不了看不见的东西！
lines.en: You cannot wound what you cannot see!
I straighten up under the eaves.
Here, friend of darkness!
Darkness is my nest!
Hidden in the dark!

lines.zh: 我在黑里待了六十秒，够了。
lines.en: Sixty seconds in the dark is enough.
I crouch in the dark, head against the beam.
The lamps die and I stand tall.
In the dark, you can't escape!
I have stood in the dark for sixty seconds.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我探出五格高的身子。
lines.en: Five blocks tall, I lean out of the dark.

lines.zh: 故事开始了，我站在你身后。
lines.en: The story starts; I stand behind you.

lines.zh: 你先听见呼吸，才看见我。
lines.en: You hear my breath before you see me.

lines.zh: 五格半高，贴着天花板出现。
lines.en: Five and a half blocks tall, I appear at the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这一轮猎杀，从我睁眼开始。
lines.en: This hunt begins when I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我来得不快，但一定会来。
lines.en: I do not come fast, but I always come.
The instant the light dies, I am here.
Do not look for the exit; look for me.
Your story is missing one thing: me.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，地板就静了。
lines.en: I take one step and the floor goes quiet.

lines.zh: 黑暗先来，我跟着黑暗来。
lines.en: Darkness comes first; I come with it.

lines.zh: 我被你伤到了，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: You hurt me! — and the fire makes it worse.
I slid down from the height!

lines.zh: 别那么近，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Stay away! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你的攻击无效，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Your attack fails! — and the explosion makes it worse.
An arrow has pinned my shoulder.

lines.zh: 小心我的爪子，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Watch out for my claws! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 你打不到我，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Can't hit me! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 五格高的我，在黑暗里缩。
lines.en: Five blocks tall, shrinking in the dark.

lines.zh: 别来惹我，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Don't mess with me! — and the void makes it worse.
